files.description: Note creation, editing, deletion, counter, and clear confirmation behavior

files.content:
# Pixel Notes

A small, offline sticky-note board built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server, packages, or network connection are needed.

## Use

Type a note, choose one of the four colors, and select **Add note**. Edit any note directly in its text area, or delete it with its **Delete** button. The counter updates as notes change. Select **Clear all** and confirm to remove every note.
